recipes.name: Chicken adobo
recipes.method_note: Sharp, salty and peppery. The sauce reduces to a glaze at the end.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} in a pan with {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:rice-vinegar}} and the garlic.
Simmer (small bubbles) uncovered 30 minutes, until the chicken is tender.
Lift out the chicken. Boil the sauce 5 minutes, until syrupy.
Brown the chicken in {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a frying pan, 4 minutes.
Pour the sauce back over. Serve on the rice with sliced {{ing:spring-onion}}.

swaps.text: Firm tofu or a tin of chickpeas, for a vegetarian version
Tamari, to make it gluten free
